=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24383-24394 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `source_pr_closed_unmerged_run_active` hold in `_close_sweep_check_triage_gate` uses `issue_has_active_workflow` over `ACTIVE_WORKFLOW_ISSUES`, but `build_active_issue_set` (lines 18717-18739) takes issue numbers only from `head_branch` names (`ai/issue-<n>`, `ai/<n>`, `ai-implement-<n>`). Plan and implement runs triggered by `issue_comment` report the default branch, so they are never in that set.
  WHY: An `ai:check-triage` issue whose source PR closed unmerged, while an `/approved` implement run is in flight before opening its PR, gets `ai:closed` and is closed as "not planned". The run then opens an `ai/issue-<n>` PR against a closed issue, which is the orphaned work AD-1 option B was meant to prevent. The tests hand-set `ACTIVE_WORKFLOW_ISSUES="7\n10"`, which hides the gap. README.md, agents.d and changelog.d claim more than the code does. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:28365-28372 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The idle-tick `close_merged_issues_sweep triage_only` call in the `STANDALONE_RECOVERY_SWEEP_ONLY` branch runs only in the workflow step gated by `steps.validate_env.outcome == 'success'` (.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1561). `validate_env` is skipped when `ENABLE_STANDALONE_STALL_RECOVERY=false`, so turning off standalone recovery also turns off the idle-tick triage gate, and nothing documents this.
  WHY: On repos with no tracking issue and standalone recovery disabled, the fix for the #820 / #828 / btc_sweeper#207 shapes does nothing and stuck triage issues stay open indefinitely. The README.md and agents.d/9481-check-triage-close-gaps.md text says the pass runs unconditionally. Severity disagreement: minimax MAJOR, sonnet and glm NIT, gemini unstated; the highest is used. Gemini cited `close_merged_issues_sweep` (around line 5576), and minimax cited the file as .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:28365-28372 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: In `triage_only` mode on idle ticks, the sweep also runs the ordinary merged-candidate closes: `set_issue_phase_label ai:merged` (line 5909) and `gh issue close` (line 5916). `CHECK_TRIAGE_RESOLVED_GATE_ENABLED=false` stops only `_check_triage_gate_invoke`, the window is computed regardless (lines 5660-5681), and `ENABLE_CLOSE_MERGED_ISSUES` is not forwarded by orchestrate_poll.yml, so it is always `true` (line 3152).
  WHY: An operator who sets the documented kill switch still sees `ai:check-triage` issues relabelled and closed on idle ticks, including through the new `check_triage_marker_pr_base` rule. So the agents.d text and the README "turns the gate off in all four places" row are inaccurate.
- scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:683 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_default_branch_content_fallback()` compares the source PR's `merge_sha` with the default branch instead of the implementation fix PR's merge commit.
  WHY: If the fix landed through a different PR, the check validates the wrong content, but the requirement was to verify that the fix PR's content is reachable.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24328 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `ensure_label_exists "ai:closed" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true` does not check whether the label exists or was created before `gh issue edit` runs.
  WHY: If creating the label fails (API error or permissions), the label add also fails, and the issue can end up closed without its label.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24345-24353 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The comment says a missing cross-reference `state` is "read as unreadable (fail closed)". In fact the jq filter treats a missing state as not-closed and keeps the PR in `_ctg_open_prs`; the later `_fetch_pr_json` decides the hold.
  WHY: Runtime behaviour is still safe because the fetch is authoritative, but the comment misleads maintainers, and someone tightening the filter later could flip the behaviour. Minimax rated it NIT (confidence 3); gemini gave no severity (confidence 4).
- scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:692 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The rename and removed-file checks in `_tree_match()` rely on the GitHub PR `files` list matching the PR's state relative to the evidence commit.
  WHY: If the file status the API reports disagrees with the actual tree, the result can be a false negative and the gate fails to recognise a fix.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24337-24340 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The check `(.state // "") == "closed" and .merged != true` logs `reason=source_pr_state_changed` even when `state` is null or missing, so the state is unknown rather than changed.
  WHY: It fails closed, so the outcome is correct, but the log reason is misleading, and a log-grepping consumer such as an alert rule could treat it as a real state change.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "For a non-default base whose integration PR is missing, fall back to checking that the default-branch check is green and that the fix PR's merge commit content is reachable from the default branch, or leave the issue open with a logged reason."
  expected_change_site: scripts/check_triage_resolution.py, `_default_branch_content_fallback` and `_tree_match`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The fallback uses the source PR's merge commit (`triage["pr"]` / `merge_sha`, lines 680 and 722) instead of the fix PR's. `_default_branch_content_fallback` reads `repos/{repo}/compare/{merge_sha}...{evidence}` and `_tree_match` reads `repos/{repo}/pulls/{triage['pr']}/files`. The gate never receives or fetches the fix PR's identity or merge commit, and it does not search the timeline for a cross-referenced `ai/issue-<N>` PR (#750 / #752 / #753 case). Gemini rated this BLOCKER; minimax and openai rated it MAJOR. Counter-evidence: sonnet and glm say the triaged PR is the PR carrying the fix (AD-2 shape), so they see no gap.
- requirement: "In the orchestrator poller, hold the close sweep while a pipeline run for the issue is active (`issue_has_active_workflow`)"
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, `_close_sweep_check_triage_gate`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: `build_active_issue_set` (and so `issue_has_active_workflow`) matches only `.head_branch` values `ai/issue-<n>`, `ai/<n>` and `ai-implement-<n>`. Plan and implement runs triggered by `issue_comment` report the default branch, so the hold never fires for them. Gemini rated this MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24383-24394 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The AD-1 option B hold in `_close_sweep_check_triage_gate` calls `issue_has_active_workflow` (line 18744) over `ACTIVE_WORKFLOW_ISSUES` from `build_active_issue_set` (lines 18717-18739). That set matches only `ai/issue-<n>`, `ai/<n>` and `ai-implement-<n>` head branches, and `issue_comment`-triggered plan and implement runs (workflow-templates/ai-plan.yml line 5, workflow-templates/ai-implement.yml line 5) report the default branch.
  WHY: A check-triage issue whose source PR closed unmerged, while an implement run is in flight with no PR yet, gets `ai:closed` and is closed as "not planned", which orphans the run. The tests hand-set `ACTIVE_WORKFLOW_ISSUES="7\n10"`, and the README, agents.d and changelog.d claim more than the code does. Fix: return 1 with `triage_rule=skip reason=source_pr_closed_unmerged_run_active` when `${RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/stall_check_triage_issue_<n>.json` labels include `ai:planning` or `ai:implementing`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:28365-28372 (with 5559-5585, 5660-5681) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The idle-tick `close_merged_issues_sweep triage_only` also runs merged-candidate closes (`set_issue_phase_label ai:merged` line 5909, `gh issue close` line 5916). `CHECK_TRIAGE_RESOLVED_GATE_ENABLED=false` stops only `_check_triage_gate_invoke`, and `ENABLE_CLOSE_MERGED_ISSUES` is not forwarded by orchestrate_poll.yml, so it is always `true` (line 3152). The idle pass also requires `validate_env` (orchestrate_poll.yml line 1561), which is skipped when `ENABLE_STANDALONE_STALL_RECOVERY=false`, and this is undocumented.
  WHY: The kill switch does not stop the idle-tick triage closes, and disabling standalone recovery silently disables gating for the #820 / #828 / btc_sweeper#207 cases. Fix: return 0 early in `triage_only` mode when the cap is 0 or the gate is disabled, and add one doc sentence.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. The reviewer says every #9481 deliverable and AD-3 has a hunk, and declined the claim that the fallback checks the source PR instead of the fix PR because the triaged PR's merge commit already contains the fix.
- HARDENING (3 related items, risk score 3): the phase-label hold before `ensure_label_exists "ai:closed"` (~24395, 5 lines); an early `triage_only` return after line 5551 with `CLOSE_MERGED_SWEEP outcome=skip reason=triage_only_disabled` (4 lines); rewording the cross-reference comment at 24345-24346 (2 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
